q: As a boy, Samuel served the LORD under which priest?
why: Samuel grew up in the house of the LORD.
quote: And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli.

q: When the LORD first called young Samuel at night, what did Samuel answer?
why: Samuel was ready to listen.
quote: Then the LORD called to Samuel, and he answered, “Here I am.”

q: When young Samuel heard his name called at night, who did he think was calling?
why: He did not yet know the LORD's voice.
quote: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”

q: How many times did the LORD call young Samuel before Eli realized it was God?
why: Then Eli knew the LORD was calling the boy.
quote: Once again, for the third time, the LORD called to Samuel.

q: What did Eli tell young Samuel to say if God called him again?
a: Speak, LORD, Your servant is listening
why: Samuel learned to listen to God.
quote: Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.

q: Where was young Samuel lying down when God called him?
a: In the temple of the LORD
why: The ark of God was there.
quote: Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was located.

q: As Samuel grew up, what did all Israel come to know about him?
why: The LORD was with Samuel.
quote: knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.

q: After God rejected King Saul, to whose family did He send Samuel to find a new king?
why: God had chosen a king from Jesse's sons.
quote: I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem

q: When Samuel was impressed by Jesse's tall son, what did God say He looks at?
why: People judge by looks, but God sees inside.
quote: For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.

q: How many of Jesse's sons passed before Samuel without being chosen?
why: The LORD had not chosen any of them.
quote: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel

q: When Samuel came to anoint a new king, where was Jesse's youngest son?
why: No one thought the youngest would be chosen.
quote: “There is still the youngest,” Jesse replied, “but he is tending the sheep.”

q: What did Samuel use to anoint young David?
why: He anointed David in front of his brothers.
quote: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers

q: After Samuel anointed David, what came upon him?
why: From that day God's Spirit was with David.
quote: and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward.

q: When King Saul was troubled, what instrument did young David play for him?
why: Saul felt better when David played.
quote: David would pick up his harp and play

q: Which Philistine champion challenged the army of Israel?
why: He was a giant warrior from Gath.
quote: Then a champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out from the Philistine camp.

q: When Goliath shouted his challenge, how did Saul and the Israelites feel?
why: No one wanted to fight the giant.
quote: Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and greatly afraid.

q: Before facing Goliath, which wild animals did David say he had fought while keeping sheep?
why: God had already helped David against them.
quote: and whenever a lion or a bear came and carried off a lamb from the flock

q: Why did David take off King Saul's armor before facing Goliath?
a: He was not used to it
why: David trusted God, not armor.
quote: I am not accustomed to them.

q: How many smooth stones did David choose from the brook before facing Goliath?
why: He put them in his shepherd's bag.
quote: selected five smooth stones from the brook

q: Facing Goliath, in whose name did David say he came?
why: Goliath had defied the living God.
quote: but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts

q: Where did David's stone hit Goliath?
why: The giant fell facedown.
quote: striking the Philistine on the forehead.

q: With what did young David defeat Goliath?
why: God gave the victory without a sword in David's hand.
quote: Thus David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone

q: After David defeated Goliath, whose soul became knit together with David's?
why: Jonathan, Saul's son, loved David as himself.
quote: the souls of Jonathan and David were knit together

q: Why did Jonathan make a covenant with David?
why: They became best friends.
quote: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

q: What did Jonathan give David as a sign of their friendship?
why: He also gave David his tunic and belt.
quote: And Jonathan removed the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, his sword, his bow, and his belt.

q: What song of the women made King Saul jealous of David?
a: Saul his thousands, David tens of thousands
why: Saul was angry that David got more praise.
quote: Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.

q: In his jealousy, what did King Saul throw at David?
why: David escaped that night.
quote: Saul tried to pin him to the wall with his spear.

q: To send David a secret warning, what did Jonathan plan to shoot?
why: Where the arrows landed would tell David what to do.
quote: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it

q: When David and Jonathan said goodbye, what did they do?
why: David had to flee from Saul.
quote: Then he and Jonathan kissed each other and wept together

q: When King Saul hunted David with three thousand men, where was David?
why: Saul was told where David was hiding.
quote: David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

q: When Saul stepped into a cave at En-gedi, who was hiding deep inside?
why: Saul did not know they were there.
quote: And David and his men were hiding in the recesses of the cave.

q: In the cave at En-gedi, what did David secretly cut off?
why: David could have killed Saul, but he did not.
quote: Then David crept up secretly and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.

q: Why would David not harm King Saul in the cave?
why: David left Saul's fate to God.
quote: May I never lift my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.

q: How did David feel after cutting the corner of Saul's robe?
why: Even that small act felt wrong to him.
quote: Afterward, David’s conscience was stricken

q: After David spared his life, what did King Saul say to him?
a: You are more righteous than I
why: David had repaid evil with good.
quote: You are more righteous than I

q: When Saul heard David calling to him outside the cave, what did Saul do?
why: Saul was moved by David's mercy.
quote: Then Saul wept aloud

q: Who were the two wives of Elkanah, Samuel's father?
why: Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.
quote: He had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah.

q: What did Hannah promise God if He gave her a son?
a: To dedicate him to the LORD
wrong: To give a lamb every year
why: She kept her promise.
quote: then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life

q: Why did Hannah name her son Samuel?
a: She asked the LORD for him
wrong: He was born in the temple
why: God answered her prayer.
quote: Because I have asked for him from the LORD.

q: When Samuel was a boy, how often did the word of the LORD come?
why: Visions were scarce in those days.
quote: Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare and visions were scarce.

q: When the Philistines captured the ark of God, which of Eli's sons died?
why: It was a dark day for Israel.
quote: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.

q: When Samuel was old, what did the people of Israel ask him to give them?
why: They wanted to be like other nations.
quote: Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.

q: When Israel asked Samuel for a king, whom did God say they had really rejected?
why: God was meant to be their king.
quote: For it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected Me as their king.

q: How is Saul described before he became Israel's first king?
why: He was choice and handsome.
quote: a head taller than any of the people.

q: When Samuel presented Saul to Israel as king, what did the people shout?
why: Saul became Israel's first king.
quote: And all the people shouted, “Long live the king!”

q: When Saul disobeyed, Samuel said the LORD had found a man after what?
why: That man would be David.
quote: the LORD has sought a man after His own heart

q: Samuel told disobedient King Saul that what is better than sacrifice?
why: God wants His people to listen and obey.
quote: Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice

q: Which of Jesse's sons did Samuel first think was God's chosen king?
why: Samuel judged by appearance at first.
quote: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab

q: How is young David described when he was brought in from the sheep?
why: The LORD said, “He is the one.”
quote: He was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance.

q: Goliath the giant came from which Philistine city?
why: He was the Philistines' champion.
quote: Then a champion named Goliath, who was from Gath

q: Before the battle with Goliath, what did David go back and forth to do?
why: He was still a shepherd in Bethlehem.
quote: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep in Bethlehem.

q: Why did Saul first say David could not fight Goliath?
why: Goliath had been a warrior from his youth.
quote: You are just a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth.

q: David told Goliath that God does not save by sword or spear, because the battle belongs to whom?
why: David trusted God to win.
quote: for the battle is the LORD’s

q: After Goliath fell, what did the Philistine army do?
why: Their hero was dead.
quote: When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they turned and ran.

q: Which of King Saul's daughters did David marry?
why: Saul gave her to David as his wife.
quote: Then Saul gave his daughter Michal to David in marriage.

q: After the women's song about David, how did King Saul treat him?
a: Kept a jealous eye on him
why: Saul feared David would take the kingdom.
quote: And from that day forward Saul kept a jealous eye on David.

q: While running from Saul, where did David take refuge after leaving Gath?
why: His family came to him there.
quote: So David left Gath and took refuge in the cave of Adullam.

q: Who was the wise wife of harsh Nabal?
why: She was intelligent and beautiful.
quote: His name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail.

q: Before his last battle, whom did King Saul seek out at Endor?
why: Saul had turned away from the LORD.
quote: There is a medium at Endor

q: How did King Saul die in battle with the Philistines?
a: He fell on his own sword
why: His armor-bearer was too afraid to kill him.
quote: So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

q: Elkanah, Samuel's father, came from which town?
why: It was in the hill country of Ephraim.
quote: Now there was a man named Elkanah who was from Ramathaim-zophim

q: Hannah promised that her son would never have what come over his head?
why: He would be set apart for God all his life.
quote: and no razor shall ever come over his head.

q: When God called young Samuel, what was wrong with old Eli?
why: Eli could not see.
quote: Eli, whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see

q: Samuel was known as a true prophet across Israel from where to where?
why: This meant the whole land.
quote: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew

q: Which son of Jesse was presented to Samuel right after Abinadab?
why: The LORD had not chosen him either.
quote: Next Jesse presented Shammah

q: How tall was Goliath?
why: That is about nine and a half feet.
quote: He was six cubits and a span in height

q: How much did the iron point of Goliath's spear weigh?
why: His spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
quote: and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels.

q: What was Goliath's coat of mail made of?
why: It weighed five thousand shekels.
quote: He wore a bronze coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels

q: How many Philistines did David and his men kill to become Saul's son-in-law?
why: Then Saul gave him Michal.
quote: David and his men went out and killed two hundred Philistines.

q: In Jonathan's arrow signal, which words meant David had to flee?
wrong: The arrows are on this side
why: It meant the LORD was sending David away.
quote: Look, the arrows are beyond you

q: How many chosen men did Saul take to hunt David near En-gedi?
why: They searched the rocky hills.
quote: So Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel

q: In which rocky region did Saul look for David near En-gedi?
a: The Rocks of the Wild Goats
why: David was hiding in the caves there.
quote: in the region of the Rocks of the Wild Goats.

q: Nabal, Abigail's harsh husband, belonged to which clan?
why: He was evil in his dealings.
quote: but her husband, a Calebite, was harsh and evil in his dealings.
